contract: Explicit same-project services, all positive-traffic and tagged native reconciled single-container revisions, exact native immutable image/repository/project identities, bounded offline dual detection, and fresh native service reread after image inspection.

bounds.metadata_deadline_semantics: Checked between requests plus the existing native per-request HTTP timeout; revalidation has a separate bounded metadata window.

proof: Fresh service HTTP reread deliberately evicts only an already settled exact cache entry; unchanged bodies and different request IDs required.
Consumer reconstructs the native source plan and verifies scoped GET receipts, exact field projections, successful HTTP attempts, unique source IDs and image ownership.
Raw container/source bytes never enter source proof; existing detectors retain redacted fingerprints/locations and do not verify credentials.
Default-off and exact named image check admission unchanged; no mutable tag-only or latest-ready-only negative.
Native service/revision UIDs are required. Fresh service UID comparison detects deletion/recreation even when names and generation numbers are reused.

tests.note: Initial affected cohort119passed/1engine-admission regression; directed47passed resolves it. Earlier fixture-only resealing/setup failures were corrected before that cohort.

limits: Selected services at capture time only; not project-wide/historical/inactive revisions, Run jobs or worker pools.
Multi-container revisions remain UNKNOWN because native v1 imageDigest is singular.
Cross-project images, missing/denied revisions, concurrent service changes, oversized/unsupported images remain UNKNOWN.
No source-code provenance, mounted/config/secret-store/runtime-generated contents or all-cloud/live-production certification.
